episodes.title: From a chat to an app on every assistant
episodes.logline: Mara's shop is invisible to customers' assistants until Jun builds her an app in one chat.
episodes.cliffhanger: Orders pour in at golden hour. Who is Pip, and what else can the assistants do for the shop?

episodes.title: The first update
episodes.logline: A wrong price goes live at the busiest hour. Jun ships the fix to every phone without a store review.
episodes.cliffhanger: The fix lands, but one phone in a far village still shows the old price.

episodes.title: The rush hour
episodes.logline: A festival fills the shop with orders. A bad release starts to crash, and the shop must roll back before closing.
episodes.cliffhanger: The rollback saves the evening. Then a message arrives from a shop in another country.

episodes.title: Mara's second shop
episodes.logline: Mara opens a second stall and asks her assistant to run both apps while she sleeps.
episodes.cliffhanger: Season finale: the assistants start talking to each other. Season 2 teaser.
